tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: We've been discussing the impact of major historical figures on their respective societies. Some historians argue that individuals like political leaders or influential thinkers shape the course of history more than broader social and economical forces. Others believe social and economical events are the primary drivers of historical change. What do you think has a greater impact on shaping history: individual actions or broader social and economic forces? Why?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I believe individuals and their actions have a greater impact on shaping history. Leaders and influential thinkers can inspire movements, create significant changes, and leave a lasting legacy. Their decisions and actions often alter the course of events in profound ways.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: In my opinion, broader social and economic events are more significant in shaping history. While individuals can influence events, it is the underlying conditions and trends that drive major changes. These forces affect large groups of people and create the context in which individuals operate.
